55 is the latest approved patch-set.
No files were changed between the latest approved patch-set and the submitted one.
Overall, it might be easier to review if you split this into different commits, one per handler.
I think these changes belonged to an earlier commit.
Done
PLDM OEM META commits need to be merged together.

Made three changes:

- Replaced the type representing TID from ```uint8_t``` to ```pldm_tid_t```
- Replaced the type representing file I/O type from ```uint8_t``` to ```FileIOType``` in function parameters
- Added ```getSlotNumberByTID``` function for handlers to retrieve the slot number from D-Bus
Is this related to the PLDM file transfer spec (DSP0242)?
no

Long answer, back when we were designing the interface from our controller to the BMC, we saw the IBM OEM and decided to reuse that pattern. We are not doing generic file transfer between the uC and the BMC (See the next few commits in this chain on how we extend this to get things like post-code etc).
Acknowledged
DSP0242 can do boot logs and "other" file and OEM file. Is there a plan to switch to DSP0242 or will this remain an OEM file transfer implementation?
no
No is your answer to which question?
Yes, no such plan.
If it is "maybe_unused" why do we have it?
This is just a shortcut to pass the CI. I’ve already moved the dBusHandler member to its actual usage in https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/pldm/+/82138.
General comment that applies to subsequent commits that introduce something testable: please add a tested section for testing done on an (upstream) platform
Done
Moved the dBusHandler member to https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/pldm/+/82138.

Do we really need multiple instances of oemMETA? Other OEMs don't seem to require that.

Nit: I don't think META had to be all caps here in the name (it makes sensor for IBM).

I don’t understand what you mean by “multiple instances”.

@amithash@meta.com Do you think META is okay?
Multiple objects of the OEMMeta class - do you need them?
No, we don't need.
